per_candidate.id: s2:Global properties of the growth index: Mathematical aspects and physical relevan
s2:Sub-horizon modes and growth index in a linear scalar cosmological perturbations

rationale: Paper 1912.09858 directly investigates the effect of dark matter-dark energy momentum coupling on structure formation, which is relevant to the question of reconciling CMB observations with structure growth. It provides substantive new evidence on part of the question, but does not fully settle it.
